prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman cosplayer, mid 20s, with a racing-queen heroine look brought to life, with a sleek jet-black high ponytail and long straight side strands framing her face, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her lips are full and glossy, in a vivid red gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, lightly parted. A faint rose blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose and the ears. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A bold, smoldering, slightly lowered gaze with the huge eyes looking up through her lashes. Her skin is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, and a light natural sheen only on the nose and forehead, the rest of the face in a soft natural matte finish — a photograph of a living woman's face with real flesh and warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face. Jewelry: on each ear, five separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished gold ring through the lobe, each on its own gold chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a round bell, a pyramid-shaped lump, a cube-shaped block, a hammer head, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre; on the right ear a square-sided cowbell, a teardrop-shaped sinker, a miniature anvil, a ship's anchor, a barrel-shaped weight. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered gold chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred night race pit lane with red and white lights and streaking bokeh.

Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading, and a thin rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
